title: An affine finite-type scheme over a field has a finitely generated coordinate algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] equipped with a finite-type morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Then, writing $Y\cong\operatorname{Spec}B$ with $B=\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, the induced $k$-algebra $B$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra].
